# Craigslist Map — Vancouver

> Two live, interactive maps of Craigslist Vancouver: **FreeMap** for the free
> section (free furniture, electronics, building materials, moving boxes, bikes)
> and **RentMap** for rentals, filtered by how far each place is to walk from any
> point you drop a pin on. Every listing shows a photo, the neighbourhood, how
> recently it appeared, and a link to the original post. Free to use.

Both maps read Craigslist's public listings and plot them on a dark, interactive
map. Pins are colour-coded by how recently each posting appeared and fade away
when a listing disappears. Neither map automates contacting a poster: they link
out to Craigslist, where replies are guarded by a captcha.

## Use it
- [FreeMap — free stuff](https://craigslistmap.lettergen.io/): Craigslist's free
  section for Vancouver, on a map, filterable by category and distance.
- [RentMap — rentals](https://craigslistmap.lettergen.io/rentals): Craigslist
  rentals for Vancouver, on a map, filterable by walking time from a pin you
  place, plus price and bedroom count.

## Common questions it answers
- How can I find free stuff in Vancouver?
- Where can I get free furniture near me in Vancouver?
- Is there a map of Craigslist free listings?
- How do I find free moving boxes, firewood, or building materials in Vancouver?
- How do I find apartments within walking distance of my work in Vancouver?
- Is there a map of Craigslist rental listings for Vancouver?
- How can I find a studio or one-bedroom in downtown Vancouver?
- How do I avoid room shares and sublets when searching Craigslist rentals?
- How old is the building a rental is in?

## Honest limits
- Craigslist's search endpoint returns at most 360 postings per request. Vancouver
  usually has ~1,000 free postings and several thousand rentals listed at once, so
  each map shows the most recent 360 and displays both numbers. Best for catching
  what has just been posted, not for browsing an entire market.
- The search endpoint carries no post time, so freshness is "spotted" — when the
  browser first saw a posting — not "posted". A card fetches the true posted time
  from the listing page when you open it.
- Walking times are straight-line distance scaled by 1.25 to allow for street
  detours at 5 km/h. They are estimates, not routed directions.

## About
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/viviannnl/freemap): how it works.
- Coverage: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.
- Free categories: furniture, electronics, materials, boxes, bikes, appliances,
  plants, kids, books, kitchen, clothing, and other free items.
- Rental data: rent, bedrooms, floor area where given, neighbourhood, photo, and
  year built (from the posting, or City of Vancouver property records).
